name: Exp_CaudateXPeriodCandle_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades based on the CaudateXPeriodCandle custom indicator, which identifies specific candlestick patterns (caudate/tailed candles) across multiple periods. It includes a time filter (Tm) to restrict trading to certain hours, and a Plus module for additional position management features like trailing stops and breakeven functionality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CaudateXPeriodCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标识别多个周期的特定K线形态（带尾蜡烛）。它包含时间过滤器（Tm）限制特定交易时段，以及Plus模块提供追踪止损和保本等额外的仓位管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CaudateXPeriodCandle指标识别的带尾K线形态，这种形态表示市场在某一方向遭到拒绝后可能反转。入场条件为指标发出买入或卖出信号时开仓，配合时间过滤器仅在指定时段内交易以避开高波动或低流动性时段。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、追踪止损和保本止损机制，Plus模块增强了出场灵活性。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面提供了止盈止损比例控制，但缺少最大回撤限制等高级风控措施。整体策略依赖单一K线形态信号，缺乏多维度确认机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the CaudateXPeriodCandle indicator which identifies tailed candlestick patterns, signaling market rejection at price levels and potential reversals. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator generates a buy or sell signal, combined with a time filter that restricts trading to specific sessions to avoid high volatility or low liquidity periods. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, plus trailing stop and breakeven functionality through the Plus module for enhanced trade management. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides risk-reward ratio control through TP/SL settings, but lacks advanced risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or equity protection. The overall strategy relies on a single candlestick pattern signal without multi-dimensional confirmation, which may lead to increased false signal entries.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when money management is disabled)

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MaximumRisk
parameters.description: 最大风险比例（资金百分比）

pros: 结合时间过滤器避开不利交易时段，降低风险
Plus模块提供追踪止损和保本功能，增强盈利保护
支持固定手数和动态仓位计算，适应不同资金规模
基于多周期K线形态信号，比单一周期更可靠
可反转信号方向，灵活适应不同市场观点
pros_en: Time filter avoids unfavorable trading sessions and reduces risk
Plus module provides trailing stop and breakeven for profit protection
Supports both fixed and dynamic lot sizing for different account sizes
Multi-period candlestick pattern signals are more reliable than single timeframe
Signal reversal option adds flexibility for different market perspectives
cons: 依赖单一K线形态指标，缺乏多维度确认容易产生假信号
缺少最大回撤保护和账户净值监控机制
追踪止损和保本参数默认为0，新手可能忽略配置
没有考虑点差和滑点过滤，在流动性差的市场可能受损
时间过滤器仅支持小时级别，无法精确到分钟级别控制
cons_en: Relies on a single candlestick pattern indicator without multi-confirmation, prone to false signals
Lacks maximum drawdown protection and account equity monitoring
Trailing stop and breakeven default to 0, beginners may overlook configuration
No spread or slippage filter, risking losses in low-liquidity markets
Time filter supports only hour-level granularity, no minute-level precision
improvements: 增加多指标确认机制，如结合趋势指标或成交量过滤减少假信号
添加最大回撤保护和账户净值监控，增强整体风控能力
加入点差过滤和最小止盈点数检查，避免在不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation such as trend filters or volume screening to reduce false signals
Implement maximum drawdown protection and equity monitoring for better overall risk control
Add spread filter and minimum take-profit checks to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 缺少最大回撤保护机制，连续亏损可能导致较大资金损失
追踪止损和保本默认禁用，新手用户可能在高波动市场面临较大风险
单一K线形态信号在震荡市中容易产生连续假信号
risk_points_en: No maximum drawdown protection, consecutive losses may cause significant capital depletion
Trailing stop and breakeven are disabled by default, novice users face higher risk in volatile markets
Single candlestick pattern signal prone to consecutive false signals in ranging markets

It includes a time filter (Tm) to restrict trading to certain hours, and a Plus module for additional position management features like trailing stops and breakeven functionality.
